Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Femoral kartilajda difüz incelme ve yer yer desktrüksiyon izlenmektedir.Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında hafif darama izlenmiştir.Ekleme komşu femur medial kondilde subkondral alanda 8x3 mm boyutlu osteokondral defekt izlenmiştir.Tibial kartilajda incelmeler izlenmektedir.Suprapatellar bursa ve diz eklem mesafesinde minimal sıvı artışı izlenmiştir.Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapıların sinyal intensiteleri doğaldır.Prepatellar düzeyde cilt altı yağ dokuda yaygın ödem izlenmiştir.Sonuç: Gonatroz, femur medial kondilde osteokondral defekt, medial menisküste grade III, lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati, anterior çapraz bağda miksoid dejenerasyon, suprapatellar bursa diz ekleminde sinovit, medial kollateral ligamanda grade I sprain, prepatellar bursit.

FINDINGS:

There is a small knee joint effusion with no popliteal cysts.

There is full-thickness cartilage loss involving the lateral patellar facet with subchondral reactive and cystic changes. There is also thinning of the cartilage involving the central and lateral portion of the femoral trochlea. There is mild thinning and superficial fraying involving the cartilage of the medial lateral compartments. There are no other regions of full-thickness cartilage loss.

There is severe intrasubstance degeneration involving the body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus with a degenerative horizontal tear. The medial meniscus demonstrates mild intrasubstance degeneration of the body and posterior horn without a well-defined linear tear.

Otherwise the anterior cruciate ligament, the posterior cruciate ligament, the extensor mechanism, the medial collateral ligament, the pes anserine tendons, the semimembranosus, the popliteus, the distal biceps femoris, the lateral collateral ligament and the IT band are unremarkable.

CONCLUSION:

1. Moderate degenerative change of the knee most pronounced at the patellofemoral joint as detailed above.

2. Intrasubstance degeneration involving the medial and lateral meniscus more pronounced involving the anterior horn laterally with a degenerative horizontal tear.

3. Small knee joint effusion with no popliteal cysts.
